g.text: ELE-002 I/O LIST AND CABLE SCHEDULE
Down Home Creole · dry blending and packing plant · 6,000 lb/day

svg.text: I/O LIST · PLC-601 and PLC-602 · 117 points
bag dump integral collector fan running
salt bag spout access door closed
blender cover interlock closed (status; safety via SR-607)
bulk bag spout clamped / bag present
bag at target weight (from filler controller)
blending safety relay outputs on (all e-stops reset)
line A bag discharger screw running
station B bag discharger screw running
reject bin door closed and locked
line A bag discharger screw start
station B bag discharger screw start
7C x 18 AWG [0.82 mm²] shielded TC-ER, 600 V
12C x 18 AWG [0.82 mm²] shielded TC-ER, 600 V
19C x 18 AWG [0.82 mm²] shielded TC-ER, 600 V
1. Wire number = PLC-slot-channel; both ends ferruled and labelled with the same number.
2. Field device terminal = cable number + core number (e.g. W-305/3).
3. 24 V DC from PS-608, 0 V bonded to PE at one point per panel.
4. Analog cables shielded, shield grounded at the panel end only.
5. E-stops are hard-wired dual channel to SR-607; PLC sees SRxxx_OK status only.
